# Vendored front-end assets

Served locally so the web UI works offline and on networks that block CDNs.

| Asset | Version | Source | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `bootstrap/bootstrap.min.css`, `bootstrap/bootstrap.bundle.min.js` | Bootstrap 5.3.3 | `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.3/dist/` (SRI hashes verified against getbootstrap.com) | MIT |
| `bootstrap-icons/` (CSS + `fonts/`) | Bootstrap Icons 1.11.3 | `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/font/` | MIT |
| `fonts/plus-jakarta-sans-*.woff2` | Plus Jakarta Sans (variable), Fontsource 5.1.1 | `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@fontsource-variable/plus-jakarta-sans@5.1.1/files/` | SIL Open Font License 1.1 |

To upgrade, download the new files to the same paths and update the versions above.
